notes:
Play manual for Lantern Cave (terminal text adventure)

How to play (controls):
- The game accepts line-based commands. Type a command then press Enter.
- Supported commands (case-insensitive): look, go north, go south, go east, go west, take <item>, inventory, help, quit.
- The game also supports redirected stdin for automated tests; it uses input() so non-interactive runs work.
- Arrow keys/physical key handling: not implemented. Use full words like 'go north'.

Test input example (provided above) is the Plan's example script. It navigates, picks up the lantern and rusty key, and ends with quit. Note: the example does not reach the treasure room; to win, move from the lake east into the treasure room while holding 'rusty key'.

Output formatting rules (implemented exactly as required):
- Every command prints one fixed confirmation line first (e.g. LOOK, MOVED NORTH, BLOCKED, TOOK <item>, INVENTORY, HELP, QUIT or UNKNOWN COMMAND), then a short descriptive text when applicable.
- After each command the current location name is printed on its own line.
- Taking an item that is present prints 'TOOK <item>' then a short sentence. Taking a non-present item prints 'TOOK <item>' then 'There is no <item> here.'
- Moving into the treasure room while carrying 'rusty key' prints MOVED <DIRECTION>, the room description, then 'WIN' and exits.

Implemented files and responsibilities:
- game/lantern_cave.py: main game logic, map, state, parser, run loop. Implements all requirement behaviors and prints outputs exactly as specified.
- game/__init__.py: package marker (empty).

Known limitations and notes:
- Item name matching is case-insensitive but must otherwise match exactly (e.g., 'rusty key').
- Arrow-key direct reading is not implemented; use textual commands for movement.
- No persistence; quitting or exiting ends the process with no save file.

If you need a different automated test sequence that demonstrates the WIN condition, use: go east\ntake lantern\ngo west\ngo south\ngo south\ntake rusty key\ngo east
